articles.summary: Pilot Applies ISO 14075:2024 Framework to Explore Social Conditions in Material Production Interface, Inc. (NASDAQ: TILE), the global flooring and sustainability leader, completed a pilot Social Life Cycle Assessment (S-LCA) of natural rubber used within select nora® rubber flooring products. The company is the first flooring manufacturer to publish an ISO-compliant S-LCA covering the life cycle of natural rubber production with one of its suppliers. The pilot helps build a broader understanding of product impact by exploring the people and communities connected to material production. “Our path to carbon negative by 2040 depends on innovation, transparency, and collaboration across our supply chain. The same communities that help produce the materials we rely on also experience the effects of climate change most directly,” said Liz Minné, Head of Global Sustainability Strategy at Interface. “Environmental LCAs help us understand carbon impacts. articles.title: Interface Completes Social Life Cycle Assessment of Natural Rubber
